versions.content: A service operation shall only be added to the queue if the data consistency of the job structure can be guaranteed. This shall be particularly considered when services with the same jobID are added to the queue (e.g. with subsequent calls to Csm_SignatureVerify() and Csm_SaveContextJob()). If this cannot be guaranteed, the service operation shall return with E_BUSY.
